rows.en: (What should I do after school today...)

\p-san,
is something the matter?
rows.notes: x6: Luca (frd_luk_114) and Nanase (nml_nns_010/014), both genders; works for all.

rows.en: I've got nothing to do, y'know.

I see...
Well then...
rows.notes: x2, Luca, both genders; he is about to leave.

rows.en:
Now now now now...
Let's stop somewhere on the way home~
Lucaaa~
rows.notes: Male. Whiny voice, which Luca calls out in c09698.

rows.en:
Please don't use that weird voice...
So, where do you want to stop?
Hmm~ Where would be good?

You haven't decided...?
Then please come along to the place
I want to stop by.
Deep Akihabara, huh?
rows.notes: Male. Spoken, no brackets in the Japanese.

rows.en:
A part I've been wanting just came out
recently, you see.
Then let's go buy those parts!
I've got nothing to do~

Hey hey heyyy~
Let's stop somewhere on the way home~
Luca-kuuun~
Oh, Deep Akihabara, huh?

Again...?
I'm not tagging along with you today...

Whaaat?! Don't leave me behind, Lucaaa~
Let's go have some fun on the way home~
Lucaaa~

Please don't whine at me in that weird voice...
Fine, you win...
rows.notes: x2, Luca, both genders. wakarimashita kara = okay, I get it.

rows.en: Is Deep Akihabara okay again today?
Yeah, anywhere's OK by me.

This town's always so dim,
no matter when you come.

It's an underground town, after all.
Just like the name says.
rows.notes: x2, Luca, both genders. 'Deep' in the name = underground.

rows.en: Alright, let's go shopping right away.
I've got nothing to do.

Whaaat?! Don't leave me behind, Luca-kuuun!
Let's go have some fun on the way home~
Yeah, anywhere's OK by me!

This town's always so dim,
no matter when you come.

(Right, I had simulator training
with Luca today.)

We shouldn't waste any time.
Let's head to the facility.

Getting ready took me forever.
Sorry, Luca.
No, I know how much of a hassle it is.
rows.notes: x2, Luca, both genders. kurou wa wakattemasu.

rows.en: Well then, let's give it a try.
Ngh, I lost...

Man, all that practice paid off!
That was a good match, Luca.

Looks like there's nothing left
for me to teach you.

Th-That's not true!
I can't handle Ghosts at all!!

No, \p-san, I'm sure
you can do anything.

Flattering me won't get you anything,
you know?

Ahahaha!
Shall we go one more round?

(Right, I had simulator training
with Luca-kun today.)

Getting ready took me forever.
Sorry, Luca-kun.
It makes me happy to hear you say that.
Well then, let's give it our all today too.

Ahah, all that practice paid off!
That was a good match, Luca-kun!

Th-That's not true!
I can't handle Ghosts at all!!

Geez... Flattering me won't get you
anything, you know?

(I had simulator training with Luca
again today.)
Well then, let's head to the facility.
Looks like you're all set, Luca.
Let's get started right away.
Ooh, you're really fired up.
Haha, today's win goes to me.

Ngh... I lost...
Was last time just a fluke...?

I studied your behavior patterns inside out,
so of course you lost.
...Th-That's so petty, Luca!
I'll do whatever it takes to win.
Grrr!! I demand a rematch!!
Bring it on!
rows.notes: x4: Luca here, Ranka in nml_she_020 (accepting Sheryl's challenge); fits both.

rows.en:
(Simulator training with Luca-kun
again today.)
I just got here too.
Looks like you're all set, Luca-kun.
Oho? You're really fired up, huh?
...Th-That's so petty, Luca-kun!
Grrr!! I demand a rematch!!
